key_insight: The paper provides the first quantitative, topology-based definition of churn flow using Euler Characteristic Surfaces (ECS) and uses Multiple Kernel Learning (MKL) on ECS-derived kernels to unsupervisedly discover and correct regime labels (including a corrected Wu flow‑regime map) in small‑diameter vertical pipes.
problem_solved: Churn flow has lacked a rigorous mathematical definition for decades, and existing empirical regime maps (e.g., Wu map) mislabel or miss transitions in small‑diameter pipes; this work automates discovery and correction of regimes without supervision.
method: Compute Euler Characteristic Surfaces χ(s,t) from spatio‑temporal two‑phase flow data to capture topological signatures across scales and time.
Construct two complementary ECS-derived kernels: (a) temporal alignment via L1 distance on the χ(s,t) surface, and (b) amplitude/statistics kernel using scale-wise mean, std, max, min.
Fuse kernels with Multiple Kernel Learning to perform unsupervised regime discovery and apply corrections to the Wu flow‑regime map.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners with robust, topology-based features and an unsupervised pipeline for discovering complex flow regimes—reducing reliance on labeled data, improving physical interpretability, and enabling better model inputs for physics‑informed ML and monitoring systems.
visual_elements: Schematic of a small‑diameter vertical pipe annotated with canonical flow regimes and a highlighted churn region.
3D surface plot of an Euler Characteristic Surface χ(s,t) showing temporal oscillations distinctive of churn flow.
Diagram of the MKL pipeline: two ECS-derived kernels (temporal alignment + amplitude stats) combining into unsupervised clustering and corrected Wu map output.
Before/after map comparison (original Wu map vs. MKL‑corrected regime map) as a colored heatmap to show corrected boundaries and labels.
paper_title: Topological Characterization of Churn Flow and Unsupervised Correction to the Wu Flow-Regime Map in Small-Diameter Vertical Pipes
paper_authors: Brady Koenig, Sushovan Majhi, Atish Mitra, Abigail Stein, Burt Todd
